duplicate_policy: Six duplicate input candidates receive explicit alias fates; none is separately counted as an active canonical mechanism.
comparison_policy: Original fields are inspectable; specific manual rationales determine equivalence. Similar labels, common source IDs and disposition agreement do not establish equivalence.

relation_type_definitions.EXACT_EQUIVALENT: Same scoped proposition, bearer, mechanism and critical guard; wording/source-access may differ.
relation_type_definitions.SUBSTANTIALLY_EQUIVALENT: Same operative criterion and failure control with preserved refinements that do not alter its bearer.
relation_type_definitions.A_STRICTLY_REFINES_B: A specifies a stricter aspect of the common criterion without claiming B stated the stronger guarantee.
relation_type_definitions.B_STRICTLY_REFINES_A: B specifies a stricter aspect of the common criterion without claiming A stated the stronger guarantee.
relation_type_definitions.A_SPLITS_B: A's separately counted facets motivate distinct canonical targets for a bundled B row; any residual not present in A remains explicitly marked.
relation_type_definitions.B_SPLITS_A: B's distinct facets motivate separate canonical targets for a bundled A row; no source scope is silently enlarged.
relation_type_definitions.PARTIAL_OVERLAP_DISTINCT_RESIDUALS: Some semantics overlap, but the retained residual criterion, bearer or logical polarity is distinct.
relation_type_definitions.DISTINCT_A_ONLY: No equivalent separately counted B property established; not a claim the B report never discussed the topic.
relation_type_definitions.DISTINCT_B_ONLY: No equivalent separately counted A property established; not a claim the A report never discussed the topic.
relation_type_definitions.DUPLICATE_WITHIN_A: Preserved A proposal/row aliases existing canonical mechanism(s), not an additional active mechanism.
relation_type_definitions.DUPLICATE_WITHIN_B: Preserved B proposal/row aliases existing canonical mechanism(s), not an additional active mechanism.
relation_type_definitions.SUPERSEDED_BY_STRONGER_CANONICAL_FORM: The older formulation is preserved but a more defensible narrowed/qualified form governs.
relation_type_definitions.CONTRADICTORY_OR_INCOMPATIBLE_JUDGEMENT: Equivalent scope with materially incompatible judgement; resolve by evidence or preserve uncertainty.
relation_type_definitions.SAME_MECHANISM_DIFFERENT_GUARD: The mechanism is common but trigger, assumptions or omission boundaries differ and must be retained.
relation_type_definitions.SAME_FAILURE_DIFFERENT_MECHANISM: A similar failure is controlled by non-equivalent operative mechanisms.
relation_type_definitions.SAME_MECHANISM_DIFFERENT_BEARER: Similar procedure applies to distinct subjects, so identity is not inferred.
relation_type_definitions.SOURCE_GROUNDED_VS_ANALYTICAL: Sourced mechanism and analytical derivation or adverse implication are distinguished rather than attributed to one another.
relation_type_definitions.COMPOSITION_INDUCED_EQUIVALENT: Same minimal relational bearer and mechanism survive as one analytical canonical property.
relation_type_definitions.COMPOSITION_INDUCED_PARTIAL_OVERLAP: Induced claims share parents but retain a non-equivalent residual.
relation_type_definitions.COMPOSITION_INDUCED_DISTINCT: Different relational bearer/mechanism despite composition-level origin.
relation_type_definitions.ARCHIVAL_ANCESTRY_ONLY: Historical custody uncertainty, not an additional current property input.
relation_type_definitions.UNRESOLVED_MAPPING: Evidence does not establish a defensible current target; zero current rows have this fate.
relation_type_definitions.CANONICAL_SPLIT_OF_BUNDLE: The reconciler separates distinct tests within one input row without claiming every resulting facet was independently counted by the other input.
